newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust off on profit-taking - traders.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust off on profit-taking - traders.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp was lower Monday apparently on profit-taking after the stock closed at an all-time high of 85-1/2 Friday, traders said.
Bankers Trust was down two to 83-1/2 in afternoon trade.
A Bankers Trust spokesman declined comment on the stock move.

One trader noted that after the recent third quarter earnings, Lehman Brothers analyst James Rosenberg told clients J. P. Morgan & Co Inc was a better value than Bankers Trust based on future potential.
Rosenberg was not available for comment.
